title: Resample size
statement:
The original sample has [$n] rows. How many rows should each bootstrap resample have?

[______]{a}

feedback.message: 10,000 is the number of resamples, not the size of each one.

hints: The resample imitates a new sample from the population.
A new sample would have the same size as the original.
solution: Each resample has the same size as the original sample: [$n] rows (drawn with replacement).
